title: Fan Sphere
shortDescription: Find your fan community with game schedules, watch parties, groups and clips.
fullDescription:
Your crew. Every game.

Fan Sphere brings sports fans together around the teams and games they care about.

HOME
See games, nearby watch parties and your fan groups in one place.

DISCOVER
Find fan groups, watch parties and venues. Meet fans who share your interests.

GAME DAY
Browse game schedules and follow the sports and teams you love.

CLIPS
Watch and share short videos with your community. Upload content you own or have permission to share.

FAN GROUPS AND WATCH PARTIES
Join the conversation, organise a public watch party and RSVP with your crew.

OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
Home Team adds unlimited clip posting, private invite-only watch parties, full RSVP guest lists and a fan badge. MVP includes Home Team benefits plus audience analytics, a verified creator badge and featured placement in Discover. Monthly and annual plans are available. Prices, billing periods and any eligible trial are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Google Play account settings.

Public watch parties, joining fan groups, RSVPing and watching clips are available without a paid plan.

Fan Sphere is an independent fan community app.
